messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: recommended practice is insts/tests/ or tests/ ?
parts:
1) Tests should go in tests/testthat/

2) Now use test/testthat.R - it's run by R CMD check

3) You need --install-tests if you want to run test_package() after
the package is installed. You don't need it for R CMD check.

Hadley
